status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: Please see attached reproducer project! Just run ServerNodeStarter then ComputeCallerStarter's from subdirectories, the third one will fail.

Branch: [pull/7880/head] Base: [master] : No blockers found!

TeamCity --> Run :: All Results

Please review proposed Class fields marshalling change.
agoncharuk dmekhanikov

ilyak,

Change looks good to me, I think in general we shouldn't register metadata implicitly, only by explicit call.
